---
title: "052 — Glacier projections (deterministic change)"
---

Glacier extent follows the climate, not the land-use drivers, so it is not modelled (`040`
excludes glacier as an anterior class) but imposed: after each extrapolated period is
allocated, the cells a glacier model projects as glacier become `glacier`, and the cells it
projects as newly ice-free become `static`. This step writes those assignments to
`det_change_t`, which `R/allocation.R` imposes on every allocated map (`090`, `091`); the
backcast (`080`) writes the *observed* glacier change to the same table instead.

**Source.** The per-cell glacier indices from the GloGEM runs of Farinotti et al. that
NCCS-SSP-scenarios uses (`Scripts/Preparation/Deterministic_trans_prep.R`,
`Data/Glacial_change/median_scenarios/`), one file per RCP: a whitespace table with 10 header
lines, an `ID_loc` column and one 0/1 column per 5-year step from 2005 to 2100. `ID_loc` is the
cell number (row-major from the top-left) in the original's 100 m reference grid, which has the
same extent as `coords_t` (`001`). The files are part of the NCCS-SSP-scenarios data deposit
(<https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8263509>); set `glacier_index_dir` to where they are unpacked.

**Deviation from the original.** `Dinamica_deterministic_trans.R` overwrites *every* indexed
cell each step — `1` to glacier, `0` to static — which also turns vegetation that had grown on
long-deglaciated ground back into `static`. Here a cell is set to `static` only in the step in
which it becomes ice-free (or at the first step, if the index already has it ice-free where the
2018 survey still shows glacier). Note that the NCCS-SSP-scenarios simulations themselves ran
with `Deterministic_trans = N` (`Tools/Simulation_control.csv`), so this is a step beyond the
published runs.

**Climate runs.** Assignments are written to the *climate* runs, so every SSP leaf inherits the
glacier trajectory of its climate. The GWL trajectories map to RCPs by their end-of-period
warming; `current` (no further warming) takes RCP2.6, the lowest available, which still loses
the ice committed by present-day warming.

> **Open.** The area moved by these assignments is still also part of the demand `070` solves
> for; it should be taken out of the LP so the allocator does not convert glacier a second time.
> See `TODO.md`.

```{r}
#| label: glacier-params
library(data.table)
library(evoland)

source(file.path("2026-05-ssp-ch", "R", "allocation.R"))
db <- evoland_db$new(path = "ssp-ch.evolanddb")
db$id_run <- 0L

glacier_index_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "SSPCH_GLACIER_INDEX_DIR",
  file.path(getOption("evoland.cachedir"), "nccs-glacial-change", "median_scenarios")
)

rcp_by_climate <- data.table::rowwiseDT(
  climate_framing = , gwl_trajectory = , rcp = ,
  "current", NA_character_, "rcp26",
  "gwl", "stab15", "rcp26",
  "gwl", "stab20", "rcp26",
  "gwl", "rise30", "rcp45",
  "gwl", "fast30", "rcp85"
)

id_lulc_glacier <- db$lulc_meta_t[name == "glacier", id_lulc]
id_lulc_static <- db$lulc_meta_t[name == "static", id_lulc]
anchor_period <- max(db$periods_t[is_extrapolated == FALSE & id_period > 0, id_period])
extrap_periods <- db$periods_t[is_extrapolated == TRUE][order(id_period)]
```

## Read the indices

```{r}
#| label: glacier-read
index_files <- list.files(glacier_index_dir, full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot("no glacier index files - set SSPCH_GLACIER_INDEX_DIR" = length(index_files) > 0L)

read_glacier_index <- function(path) {
  idx <- fread(path, skip = 10L, header = TRUE)
  setnames(idx, c("ID_loc", seq(2005L, 2100L, by = 5L)))
  melt(idx, id.vars = "ID_loc", variable.name = "year", value.name = "is_glacier",
       variable.factor = FALSE)[, `:=`(year = as.integer(year), is_glacier = is_glacier == 1L)][]
}
glacier_index <- rbindlist(
  setNames(lapply(index_files, read_glacier_index), tolower(
    regmatches(basename(index_files), regexpr("(?i)rcp[0-9]+", basename(index_files), perl = TRUE))
  )),
  idcol = "rcp"
)
glacier_index[, .(cells = uniqueN(ID_loc), glacier_2020 = sum(is_glacier[year == 2020L])), by = rcp]
```

## Map `ID_loc` onto `id_coord`

The cell number is resolved against a raster of `coords_t`'s extent and resolution. The
mapping is checked rather than assumed: the indexed glacier of the year closest to the last
survey must largely coincide with the surveyed glacier.

```{r}
#| label: glacier-coords
coords_minimal <- db$coords_minimal
cell_size <- attr(coords_minimal, "resolution")
grid <- terra::rast(
  terra::extend(db$extent, cell_size / 2), # db$extent spans the cell centres
  resolution = cell_size,
  crs = paste0("EPSG:", attr(coords_minimal, "epsg"))
)
stopifnot(
  "coords_t does not sit on the cell centres of its extent" =
    terra::ncell(grid) == nrow(coords_minimal) &&
      !anyDuplicated(terra::cellFromXY(grid, as.matrix(coords_minimal[, .(lon, lat)])))
)
coord_cells <- data.table(
  id_coord = coords_minimal$id_coord,
  ID_loc = terra::cellFromXY(grid, as.matrix(coords_minimal[, .(lon, lat)]))
)
glacier_index <- glacier_index[coord_cells, on = "ID_loc", nomatch = NULL]

anchor_year <- as.integer(format(as.Date(db$periods_t[id_period == anchor_period, end_date]), "%Y"))
check_year <- glacier_index[, unique(year)][which.min(abs(glacier_index[, unique(year)] - anchor_year))]
observed_glacier <- db$get_query(
  "select id_coord from {lulc_read_expr} where id_period = {anchor_period} and id_lulc = {id_lulc_glacier}",
  lulc_read_expr = db$get_read_expr("lulc_data_t"),
  as_atomic = TRUE
)
indexed_glacier <- glacier_index[rcp == rcp[1L] & year == check_year & is_glacier, id_coord]
jaccard <- length(intersect(observed_glacier, indexed_glacier)) /
  length(union(observed_glacier, indexed_glacier))
message("Glacier overlap (Jaccard) of index ", check_year, " against survey: ", round(jaccard, 3))
stopifnot("ID_loc does not line up with coords_t - check the reference grid" = jaccard > 0.5)
```

## Assignments per period

The state at a period is the index year closest to the period's end. A cell is assigned
`glacier` while indexed as glacier, and `static` in the period it stops being glacier — relative
to the previous period's index, or, in the first extrapolated period, to the survey.

```{r}
#| label: glacier-assign
period_years <- extrap_periods[, .(
  id_period,
  year = vapply(as.integer(format(as.Date(end_date), "%Y")), \(y) {
    years <- unique(glacier_index$year)
    years[which.min(abs(years - y))]
  }, integer(1))
)]

assignments <- rbindlist(lapply(unique(glacier_index$rcp), function(r) {
  state <- glacier_index[rcp == r][period_years, on = "year", nomatch = NULL, allow.cartesian = TRUE][
    , .(id_coord, id_period, is_glacier)
  ]
  setorder(state, id_coord, id_period)
  state[, was_glacier := shift(is_glacier), by = id_coord]
  first_period <- min(period_years$id_period)
  state[id_period == first_period, was_glacier := id_coord %in% observed_glacier]
  state[
    is_glacier | (was_glacier & !is_glacier),
    .(rcp = r, id_period, id_coord, id_lulc = fifelse(is_glacier, id_lulc_glacier, id_lulc_static))
  ]
}))
assignments[, .(glacier = sum(id_lulc == id_lulc_glacier), deglaciated = sum(id_lulc == id_lulc_static)),
            by = .(rcp, id_period)][order(rcp, id_period)]
```

## Write onto the climate runs

```{r}
#| label: glacier-commit
climate_runs <- db$runs_t[is.na(ssp) & !is.na(climate_framing)][
  rcp_by_climate,
  on = c("climate_framing", "gwl_trajectory"),
  nomatch = NULL
][, .(id_run, climate_framing, gwl_trajectory, rcp)]
stopifnot(
  "an RCP named in rcp_by_climate has no index file" =
    all(climate_runs$rcp %in% assignments$rcp)
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(climate_runs))) {
  db$commit(
    as_det_change_t(assignments[rcp == climate_runs$rcp[i]][, id_run := climate_runs$id_run[i]]),
    det_change_table,
    method = "upsert"
  )
}
climate_runs
```

```{r}
#| label: glacier-report
db$reporting_t <- as_reporting_t(data.table::rowwiseDT(
  key = , value = ,
  "glacier_index_source", "NCCS-SSP-scenarios Data/Glacial_change/median_scenarios (GloGEM)",
  "glacier_index_files", paste(basename(index_files), collapse = ","),
  "glacier_index_jaccard_vs_survey", as.character(round(jaccard, 3)),
  "glacier_rcp_by_climate", paste(
    climate_runs[, paste0(fifelse(is.na(gwl_trajectory), climate_framing, gwl_trajectory), "=", rcp)],
    collapse = ","
  )
))
```
